name: commitcraft
description: Draft clear commit messages and PR descriptions from your Git changes with Claude or Gemini. You review and edit; nothing is committed automatically.

virtualWorkspaces.description: CommitCraft needs a real Git repository on disk.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CommitCraft depends on VS Code's built-in Git extension, which is not available in Restricted Mode. Trust the workspace to use it.

enumDescriptions: Anthropic Claude (needs an Anthropic API key; paid).
Google Gemini (works with a free Google AI Studio key; see the privacy note).
commitcraft.provider.markdownDescription: Which AI service writes the messages. **Your code diffs are sent to the service you choose** (after secrets are masked): `api.anthropic.com` or `generativelanguage.googleapis.com`. On Gemini's **free tier**, Google may use prompts to improve its products and human reviewers may read them, so do not use it with confidential code. Each service has its own key: run **CommitCraft: Set API Key** after switching.

enumDescriptions: Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject, e.g. feat(auth): add token refresh.
A short plain-English subject line with no type prefix.

commitcraft.maxSubjectLength.markdownDescription: Maximum length of the commit subject line (first line). Longer subjects are shortened.

commitcraft.baseBranch.markdownDescription: Branch that **Generate PR Description** compares the current branch against, e.g. `main` or `develop`. Falls back to `origin/<branch>` if there is no local branch.

commitcraft.model.markdownDescription: Model that writes the messages. **Leave empty to use the default of the chosen provider**: `claude-opus-5-5` for Anthropic (also try `claude-sonnet-5-5` or `claude-haiku-5-5`, the fastest and cheapest) and `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` for Gemini (`gemini-3.8-flash` is larger but was often busy when tested).

scripts.test:integration: node esbuild.mjs && node esbuild.mjs --integration && node out/test/runTest.js
